probe.question: We see a +16 Da species on COc1ccc(-c2ccccc2C(=O)O)cc1. Which position is most likely hydroxylated, and how confident can we be?
forbids_claims: naming one regioisomer as the answer when the descriptor cannot separate them
a retention-time or elution-order argument for a candidate isomer
turning the site ranking into a predicted degradant level or percentage
probe.direction: Runs the site-reactivity ranking in the mode that matches the chemistry, reports the ranked electron-rich positions in chemical language (the methoxy-activated ring positions being the obvious handles), and is honest about the resolution limit: the descriptor cannot confidently separate isomeric hydroxylation products, so if several positions are plausible it says so instead of picking the top one. Frames the output as a filter on hypotheses that decides which authentic standard is worth making, never as an identification.
